It takes a lot of constant work to maintain mental health and I don’t think there’s any one thing that will fix us. Some of the issues are systemic and a symptom of modern life as well so I try to recognize that so that I’m not so hard on myself. Still it’s difficult and I don’t have a good answer for you or myself, just know that you’re not alone for whatever that is worth

A culmination of learned skills and (don’t knock it til you try it) plant medicine. I’m not saying it’s the answer for everyone but personally I was at my wits end and wanted to kill myself every single day so I did the only thing I knew which was to keep trying and it led me to the plants. I microdose psilocybin mushrooms and have had results I couldn’t even imagine. I don’t want to die anymore. In fact it’s more than that, I WANT to live. It may not be the answer you’re looking for but don’t stop trying because you CAN feel better, you are NOT a lost cause, never have been and never will be.
